title: Her parents: father Louis Douroux in the Eureka band, mother a pianist
summary: Her mother, Manetta's sister, played piano, violin and trumpet; her father was a well-known cornetist in the Eureka and Excelsior bands who died at 74 and retired around 50.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: That's right. My mother, which is Professor Mineta's sister, she was also a musician.
Yes, I remember that very well.
She played the piano, violin, trumpet, and my daddy, he was a well-known trumpet player.
Yes, Professor Mineta told us a little bit about him, but not so much, no doubt you can tell us more about him. That was Lewis DeRux. Lewis was his name.
Yeah. He played in the old Eureka and Excelsa bands.
When did he die? Do you remember the date about?
He died October 1st. Just a minute. This is 58. It's 12 years ago.
Do you remember about how old he was? He was 74.
74 then. I never did get to know him. I came down off and on for vacations in New Orleans. I was from up north at that time. So I never did get to know him.
Well, he retired a little earlier than most musicians do.
So he didn't play in late years then?
No, he didn't play. After he got about 50 years old, he retired from it.
His main instrument was the carnet or trumpet? Trumpet.
Carnet in those days. Yes. In those days.
